bullets.bullet_text: Led enterprise IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions for financial-services modernization, using AWS, microservices, and cloud-native reference architectures to move regulated workloads from on-premises constraints toward migration-ready delivery patterns.

Owned cross-functional solution leadership across enterprise pursuits and portfolio expansion, translating HPC stress testing and analytics into executive decision-support workflows for financial-services operating decisions.

Led enterprise technical discovery and solution mapping for financial-services pursuits, using pre-sales architecture workshops to connect buyer priorities with target solutions, delivery scope, and adoption paths.

Owned cross-functional solution leadership across enterprise pursuits and portfolio expansion, building BI data models and executive views that connected modernization programs to budget, delivery, and operating decisions.

Led enterprise IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions for financial-services modernization, aligning partner sales, solution architecture, and executive sponsors through joint go-to-market planning and AWS solution roadmaps.
